description: Supported reference production host profile for loomDB. Declarative source of truth; scripts/render_host_profile.py renders the committed Kubernetes and systemd artifacts from it.

writeAuthentication.description: loomd opens its store with Loom::open_production_attested, so every write arriving over MCP is verified against the governance-signed actor registry rather than merely attributed to the actor it names. There is no field in this profile that turns that off: a tenant declares its registry and its rollback floor, or it cannot be rendered.

policy.description: Reviewed PolicySet, owned and rotated outside this repository.

actorRegistry.description: Governance-signed actor registry and its rollback floor.

trustRoot.description: Release trust root: the independently distributed loomDB public key and the signed bundle.

frontDoorIdentity.description: Workload certificate, key, and client CA for the mTLS front door.

backupSigningKey.description: The backup trust-root private key. Mounted into the backup writer alone; the engine, the independent verifier, and the rehearsal never see it.

backupTrustRoot.description: The backup trust-root public key, provisioned independently of the writer. Mounted into the verifier and the rehearsal alone.

retentionHolds.description: The legal-hold register. Mounted into retention alone; nothing that can write a backup can lift a hold.

backupOperations.description: Scheduling, retention, verification, and rehearsal around the signed-backup mechanism. loomDB signs and verifies; the platform supplies the point-in-time source and the immutable off-account target.

pointInTimeSource.description: loomd holds an exclusive advisory lock on its store for the process lifetime, so a backup job cannot read a volume a live engine is serving. The platform takes a CSI VolumeSnapshot of the tenant volume and binds it as this claim; the backup job mounts that clone and never the live volume.

immutableTarget.description: Host responsibility. loomDB links no object-storage client in any build, so it can neither write to nor delete from this target; the platform replicates the staging root into a compliance-locked bucket in an account the loomDB deployment has no credentials for.

rehearsal.description: Restores the newest verified backup to a fresh path and runs an integrity scrub. It never writes to a tenant data directory and never promotes what it restored; activating a restored store is a deliberate operator act.

observability.disabledReason: The reference image is built --no-default-features --features airgap, which compiles the OTLP exporter out entirely. Telemetry is not 'configured off' here; there is no exporter in the binary to enable. To collect metrics, build --no-default-features --features airgap,observability (telemetry with still no object-storage client), set image.build to match, set enabled to true, and add the collector to egressAllowed.
